name: personal-data-for-garmin-connect
description: Unofficial community plugin, not affiliated with or endorsed by Garmin. Read-only MCP tools for your own Garmin Connect data (sleep, HRV, resting HR, Body Battery, stress, daily summaries, activities, original .FIT files) using your own Garmin Connect Personal API key. Runs locally; sends nothing to the author. General wellness information, not medical advice.

GARMIN_PERSONAL_API_KEY.title: Garmin Connect Personal API key
GARMIN_PERSONAL_API_KEY.description: Your own key from https://connect.garmin.com/app/settings/personalApiToken (shown once when created). Expires after the period you chose (30 days to 1 year); paste a new key here to renew. Other MCP clients: set GARMIN_PERSONAL_API_KEY or GARMIN_PERSONAL_API_KEY_FILE (see README).
